[ASSISTANT_SAID] User may want to consider looking for a house with a lower purchase price, a shorter loan term, shopping around for insurance, and setting aside a budget for unexpected maintenance costs.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Monthly mortgage payment at 3.75% interest rate is approximately $1,343.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] By reducing the interest rate from 4% to 3.75%, the monthly mortgage payment decreases by approximately $89 per month, saving about $1,068 per year.
